title: Bounded finite free resolution construction
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], M a finite R-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and d a natural number. If M has a projective resolution of length at most d [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension], then M has an exact augmented resolution [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] by finite free modules [def-weil-pbc-free-module], with zero terms in every degree greater than d. No minimality condition on the differentials is asserted.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 0CXF, proof of condition (7), using Tags 00LP, 00O5, 00IK and 00NX

proof.text: For d = 0, use projective_of_projective_resolution_length_zero, then Mathlib Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing (projective modules are flat), and ProjectiveResolution.self. Its positive-degree terms are zero and hence finite free.

For d = k+1, apply exists_finite_free_resolution_data to obtain 0 → K → F_k → ... → F_0 → M′ → 0 with M′ linearly equivalent to M. Restrict to the sequence F_k → ... → M′. The zero endpoints and exactness give a monic inclusion K → F_k and an epic final map. Transport the given projective resolution along the equivalence to M′.

Apply projective_of_exact_partial_projective_resolution to show K projective. Module.Finite.of_injective makes K finite as a submodule of the finite module F_k over the Noetherian ring. Mathlib Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing makes K free, so all d+1 resolution terms are finite free.

Package the finite exact sequence as a bounded finite free projective resolution of M′, using exists_bounded_finite_free_resolution_of_exact_sequence. Compose the augmentation with the module isomorphism M′ ≅ M. The complex and all degreewise properties remain unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_bounded_finite_free_resolution {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (M : ModuleCat.{max u v} R) [Module.Finite R M]
    (d : ℕ) (h : HasProjectiveResolutionLE M d) :
    ∃ P : ProjectiveResolution M,
      (∀ i : ℕ, d < i → IsZero (P.complex.X i)) ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, Module.Finite R (P.complex.X i) ∧ Module.Free R (P.complex.X i))
